collection.title: Mitsubishi Canter 2006 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Mitsubishi Canter 2010 - 2012 model requires a 20" wiper blade for both the drivers and passengers side with a Standard Hook arm attachment. All of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle, with the option of upgrading to the Retrofit Flat type of windscreen wiper.
